Black Planet, the Life and Death Samsara Guidance Space.

An incarnation of Lin Yuan sat in this place, observing the ceaseless cycle of life and death before him.

“Life is death, and death is life; the cycles of life and death are merely different aspects of the Samsara Rule. So that’s how it is, that’s how it is…”

Lin Yuan was spirited, his understanding of the Life and Death Samsara Rule had broken through certain shackle, reaching a new level.

The Fourth Realm.

...

The Fourth Realm of the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

In the two-dimensional world, a millennium had passed, while a century had gone by in the Main Universe.

One hundred fifty years ago, Lin Yuan comprehended the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

One hundred years ago, the Life and Death Samsara Rule reached the Second Realm.

Now, after another hundred years, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Life and Death Samsara Rule had surpassed the Third Realm and attained the Fourth Realm.

“The Life and Death Samsara Rule, although it only encompasses two pillar-level Fusion Rules of life and death…”

“Essentially, it explicates the Samsara Rule. Without being in this Guiding Space, I estimate it would take over ten times longer to reach my current level.”

Lin Yuan felt quite emotional inside, due to his heaven-defying understanding, no bottleneck or shackle could block his path for long.

If it were any other Evolver, it wouldn’t just be a matter of time, they probably couldn’t cross over even at the end of their lifespan.

Not to mention other races, among Human Civilization alone, there are not a few Eleventh-Rank Evolvers stuck in the Third and Fourth Realm of pillar-level Fusion Rules.

To cultivate to the Tier 11, each is without exception, the strongest genius of their era.

“This Guiding Space is of no use to me now.”

At this moment, Lin Yuan looked around at the intertwined and fused rules of life and death, feeling no further impact in his heart, because he had now reached a realm in this fusion of rules that equaled the height of the Guiding Space.

Simply put, Lin Yuan had fully comprehended this Guiding Space.

“Now that the Life and Death Samsara Rule has reached the Fourth Realm, and several other pillar-level Fusion Rules like the Great Destruction Rule are at the Third Realm peak, I could step into the Fourth Realm at any moment…”

He thought to himself that while concurrently contemplating multiple Fusion Rules could disperse one’s focus and energy, the simultaneous advance and collision among the different Fusion Rules often brought about unexpected propulsion effects for Lin Yuan.

Whether it was the Life and Death Samsara Rule or the Great Destruction Rule, they are all part of the Chaos Rules, with the same origin.

“I can tell the Xia Qin Supreme Being to arrange for Tenth Rank Evolvers from Human Civilization to take my place.” Lin Yuan thought silently.

Since this Guiding Space was no longer effective for Lin Yuan, then he might as well rent it out, after all, according to the price previously agreed upon with the Xia Qin Supreme Being, a Guiding Space is worth one hundred million Merit Points.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan turned and left the Guiding Space.

Outside the Guiding Space.

The figure of Lin Yuan appeared.

The next moment.

Not far away, a figure with a stern face, wearing a black robe, materialized.

“Why have you come out?” the black-robed figure was taken aback and frowned at Lin Yuan.

The Black Planet’s twelve Guiding Spaces, each life was only allowed to enter a certain Guiding Space once.

In other words, they cannot be reentered.

Lin Yuan had spent just over a hundred years in the Life and Death Samsara Guidance Space before he voluntarily walked out, according to the rules of the Black Planet, he could not reenter the Life and Death Samsara Guidance Space again.

This made the black-robed figure somewhat regretful; it took Lin Yuan only fifty years to break through from the First Realm to the Second Realm in the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

Regarding talent and aptitude, he was absolutely the most monstrous, the most aberrant Tenth Rank Life in the black-robed figure’s memory.

But even if one was that monstrous and aberrant, it was extremely foolish to leave the Guiding Space before reaching the Fourth Realm of the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

“Because this Guiding Space is no longer of any use to me.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the black-robed figure and spoke.

“No longer of any use?” The black-robed figure was a little slow to react, then looked at Lin Yuan with disbelief, “You, you’ve reached the Fourth Realm?”

Only those who had reached the Fourth Realm were qualified to say that the Guiding Space was of no use to them.

One hundred years ago, Lin Yuan’s Life and Death Samsara Rule reached the Second Realm, and he unintentionally revealed his aura, disturbing the balance of life and death within the Guiding Space.

This allowed the black-robed figure to surmise that Lin Yuan had reached the Second Realm.

After that, Lin Yuan reached the Third Realm, and just now the Fourth Realm, without revealing any aura or disturbing the balance of life and death within the Guiding Space, obviously the black-robed figure did not know Lin Yuan’s exact level.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded, raised his right hand, lines of life and death coiled around his fingertips, and in a vague sense, a vast Great Wheel of Samsara appeared.

“Really the Fourth Realm?”

Seeing the Great Wheel of Samsara at Lin Yuan’s fingertips, the black-robed figure had no more doubts in his heart, but even so, he was still struck with a sense of incredulity.

So this is the Fourth Realm?

On the surface, it seemed that Lin Yuan spent fifty years to step from the First to the Second Realm, and another hundred years from the Second Realm to the Third, and then from the Third to the Fourth Realm.

The time spent breaking through each level was fifty years.

It appeared to be straightforward.

But the breakthroughs in realms are far from being so simply calculated.

The higher the level, the more time it requires to elevate just one minor realm.

Among the numerous evolved geniuses of Human Civilization, only Lin Yuan had taken several hundred to a thousand years to cultivate from the First Rank to the Seventh Rank, but from the Seventh to the Eighth Rank, they stalled for tens of thousands of years, even hundreds of thousands of years.

These are all concrete examples.

It’s even more so with the comprehension of Fusion Rules.

In the black-robed figure’s estimation, it would take Lin Yuan fifty years to step into the Second Realm and between five hundred to a thousand years to step into the Third Realm.
